verdict.rationale: Origin-country guidance is a fair question for an immigration-services provider, so the axis applies. The evidence covers visa categories (O-1, H-1B, TN, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW), fee calculators and persona pages, but nothing on consulate processing, country-specific backlogs or pages for founders from particular countries. The TN page mentions only professional categories, not origin-country guidance.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
